stances:Immigration and ICE:1.text: Co-led a 53-member letter asking HHS and CMS to stop sharing Medicaid enrollee data with ICE. “The role of HHS should be to protect the health of all those living in this country and provide essential human services, not to be a watchdog for DHS or act as immigration enforcement”

stances:Immigration and ICE:2.text: Joined a letter to DHS and ICE after an oversight visit to the Dilley detention center, asking about DNA collection from detained families. “During our visit, we learned that ICE collects DNA samples from individuals detained at the facility, including parents and children.”
stances:Immigration and ICE:2.evidence: 2026-06-13: Barragán, Castro, and Stanton Demand Transparency on DNA Collection of Detained Families at Dilley Detention Facility
